A classic Rookgaard quest in the island's main cave. Go down several floors through the cave full of trolls, orcs and minotaurs, get the {item:Key 4601} (or use a {item:Pick} to fetch it), open the way to the bear room, kill the {creature:Bear} and open the three boxes to receive a {item:Chain Armor}, a {item:Brass Helmet}, arrows and gold.
Character on Rookgaard; no minimum level (level 6 recommended).
opens the bear room; if you don't have it, use a Pick to go and get it
only if you don't have the key (see Pick Quest)
If you don't have a {item:Pick} yet, see the {wiki:Pick Quest|Pick Quest} to find out how to get one on Rookgaard.
The orcs on the lower floors are easy to shake off: you don't need to kill them all.
1. Go down through the main cave
Go to the abandoned building a little **north** of the village of Rookgaard and go down the hole.
The hole in the abandoned building north of the village
Head **east** and go down. There are {creature:Troll|Trolls} in this area.
Path east to the next way down
Go down again, as the map shows. There are some {creature:Orc|Orcs} here.
Path to the next way down
Go down once more. There are 2 to 4 {creature:Orc|Orcs}, but it's easy to run from them.
You reach the last floor: a room with 1–2 {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and a few {creature:Orc|Orcs}, with a big table.
2. Get the key (if you don't have it)
Open the hole with the pick
Use the {item:Pick} on the mud tile **just south of the big table**. A hole opens: go down through it.
The mud tile south of the big table
Down there is a chest with the {item:Key 4601}. Pick it up and climb back up the stairs.
**North of the big table** there is a switch that controls the stone that can block the door of the bear room (further north). If the stone is blocking the door, use the switch to remove it.
Next to the switch is the chest of the {wiki:Present Box Quest|Present Box Quest}.
Open the door with the {item:Key 4601}, go in and kill the {creature:Bear}.
Open the **three boxes** in the room to receive the reward.
The bear room with the three boxes
Chain Armor, Brass Helmet, 12 Arrows and 40 gold
If your way out is blocked

If someone blocks the way back, go down through the sewer grate to a room with 4 {creature:Spider|Spiders} and then go up the stairs to the **south** to return to the central room with the minotaurs and orcs.

From the central room, follow the maps in reverse: climb floor by floor through the same places you came down (where you came down through a hole, use the {item:Rope} to go up) until you come out in the abandoned building **north** of the village of Rookgaard. Then walk **south** back to the village.
The abandoned building north of the village, where you leave the cave
Without a {item:Rope} you're stuck on the lower floors: don't lose it or sell it before you leave.
